concerns.text: The plan relies on locating an open dataset with an experimental `permeability` column, but the listed verified datasets (e.g., SMILES‑Transformers, SELFormer‑smiles, RDKit‑chemical, etc.) do not contain such a column. Consequently, the pipeline will halt before any modeling, violating FR‑001 which requires acquisition of at least one dataset with experimental permeability coefficients (or an approved surrogate). The cited datasets are therefore inappropriate for the research question.
